message.militaryvehicles.controls: W/S: throttle, A/D: steering, Space: brake, %s: engine, %s: dismount. Chest + right-click: cargo.
message.militaryvehicles.role_controls: %s: fire/service · %s: howitzer stabilizers · %s: solo crew station · %s: role help. Supplies and shells go in cargo.
message.militaryvehicles.invalid_state: Unsupported vehicle state. Original data retained; use is blocked.
message.militaryvehicles.seats_full: No free seats. Return a solo gunner to the driver station to board.
message.militaryvehicles.park_first: Stop on dry ground, retract stabilizers and dismount everyone first.
message.militaryvehicles.inventory_full: Free one inventory slot for the vehicle.
message.militaryvehicles.no_space: Not enough room for this vehicle. Choose a clear, level area.
message.militaryvehicles.dry_ground: Place the vehicle on dry ground.
message.militaryvehicles.limit: The shared nearby vehicle limit has been reached.
message.militaryvehicles.placed: Vehicle placed. New tanks are empty: can + right-click. Mount and start the engine (default G).
message.militaryvehicles.deploying: Deploying: movement and fire locked for 60 ticks.
message.militaryvehicles.retracting: Retracting: movement locked until fully stowed.
message.militaryvehicles.wrong_station: Use the appropriate crew station. The gunner fires; the driver services and deploys.
message.militaryvehicles.crew_blocked: To switch stations, stop an armed vehicle on dry ground with just one crew member.
message.militaryvehicles.driver_station: Driver station. Engine stopped; start it again when ready.
message.militaryvehicles.gunner_station: Gunner station. Driving locked; look to aim, action key to fire.
message.militaryvehicles.service_park: Service: stop on dry ground with the engine running. Deploying also requires a full stop.
message.militaryvehicles.service_target: Aim at a dry, grounded, stopped vehicle with no passengers, engine off and stabilizers stowed, within 12 blocks center-to-center. Walls and other entities block the target.
message.militaryvehicles.service_resourc: Target is full, or service fuel / repair kits are missing from the source vehicle.
message.militaryvehicles.fuel_transferre: Transferred %s fuel. Minimum donor reserve: %s units.
message.militaryvehicles.repaired: Restored %s condition using one cargo repair kit.
message.militaryvehicles.recovery_blocke: Action blocked by space, permissions, world border or unloaded chunks.
message.militaryvehicles.recovered: Winch moved the target; %s fuel consumed.
message.militaryvehicles.gun_not_ready: Gun needs a shell in cargo, %s fuel, intact dry chassis, ground contact and cooldown. Howitzer needs deployed stabilizers.
tooltip.militaryvehicles.truck: Right-click a block to place; sneak + right-click to pack with cargo.
tooltip.militaryvehicles.alpha: Alpha: wide collision box; in-game acceptance testing still required.
tooltip.militaryvehicles.can: Fuel: %s/%s. Right-click a vehicle without sneaking.
help.militaryvehicles.truck_6x6: 27 cargo slots. Chest + right-click opens cargo; fuel can refuels, repair kit repairs.
help.militaryvehicles.scout_buggy: Light two-seat reconnaissance vehicle, 9 cargo slots. No weapon or special action.
help.militaryvehicles.carrier_8x8: Six seats and 18 cargo slots. The first passenger drives. Unarmed; static ramp.
help.militaryvehicles.warden_tank: Independent tracks can pivot. Seat 2 fires at hostile mobs only. Put shells in cargo; cost and cooldown follow the server rules below. Solo crew can switch stations while stopped. No block or player damage; arcade direct fire, not real ballistics.
help.militaryvehicles.fuel_tanker: Driver action transfers fuel from its own tank while retaining a reserve. Stop with engine on and aim at a dry, unoccupied, parked recipient within 12 blocks. Server limits are shown below.
help.militaryvehicles.field_workshop: Put repair kits in cargo. Driver action spends one kit to repair the vehicle under the crosshair. Both vehicles must be stopped on dry ground; your engine stays on. Server repair amount is shown below.
help.militaryvehicles.recovery_vehicle: Driver action winches a dry, unoccupied, stopped vehicle up to 0.75 blocks toward you. Needs a clear swept path; does not tow continuously or break blocks. Server cost and reserve are shown below.
help.militaryvehicles.bastion_howitzer: Driver deploys stabilizers for 60 ticks before firing. Gunner aims by looking; action consumes one shell and fuel according to the server rules below. Hostile mobs only, 64-block arcade direct fire. Retract before moving/packing.
help.militaryvehicles.lancer_ifv: Six seats and 18 cargo slots on armed tracks. Seat 2 fires the autocannon at hostile mobs only, out to 40 blocks, with wider elevation and a lighter round than the tank. Shells go in cargo; cost and reload follow the server rules below. No stabilizers required; the rear ramp and firing ports are decorative.
message.militaryvehicles.system_disabled: This system is disabled by server rules.
message.militaryvehicles.config_failed: Settings rejected. Previous rules retained; check the server log and settings file.
message.militaryvehicles.config_reloaded: Vehicle rules reloaded and sent to connected clients. Active cooldowns were not reset.
help.militaryvehicles.rules_pending: No rules received from this server yet. Local settings never override the server; /militaryvehicles config shows active values.
help.militaryvehicles.server_rules: Server rules: PvE %s · Support %s · Engine %s fuel / 10 ticks · Shared nearby vehicle limit %s.
help.militaryvehicles.server_gun: Shot: one shell and %s fuel · Reload %s ticks.
help.militaryvehicles.server_tanker: Transfer up to %s fuel · Donor reserve %s · Action cooldown %s ticks.
help.militaryvehicles.server_workshop: One cargo repair kit: up to %s condition · Action cooldown %s ticks.
help.militaryvehicles.server_recovery: Winch cost %s fuel · Reserve %s · Action cooldown %s ticks.
